description: Published Saccharomyces cerevisiae DNA polymerase epsilon (POL2) mutation-rate and in-vitro fidelity data used to test the proofreading-stage-removal model class of Paper E. Every record was read in the primary full text (Europe PMC fullTextXML / NCBI efetch) on 2026-10-21; verbatim quotes are retained. Nothing here is fitted or inferred.

in_vivo_can1.unit: x10^-8 Can-r mutants per cell per generation
in_vivo_can1.note: Medians of >=9 (Kane) or >=18 (Barbari) independent cultures with 95% CI. All strains MMR-proficient, E134-isogenic background, Shcherbakova laboratory.

kane2014.source: Kane DP, Shcherbakova PV. Cancer Res. 2014;74(7):1895-1901. PMCID PMC4310866
kane2014.verbatim_fold_quote: 150-fold, 44-fold and 370-fold, respectively, in comparison to the wild-type strain.
kane2014.verbatim_comparison_quote: mutator effect of pol2-P301R was ~50-fold higher than that of the pol2-4 mutation inactivating Pol-epsilon proofreading due to the replacement of both catalytic carboxylates at the ExoI motif with alanines

pol2-4_exonuclease_null.role: stage-free reference (both ExoI catalytic carboxylates to alanine)

barbari2018.source: Barbari SR, Kane DP, Moore EA, Shcherbakova PV. G3 (Bethesda). 2018;8(3):1019-1029. PMCID PMC5844290
barbari2018.note: This paper contains no pol2-4 arm, so its variants are compared with Kane's exonuclease-null allele after normalising each paper to its own wild type. Cross-paper step, flagged as such.

pol2-A979V.note: printed A966V in Table 1 and body text, A969V in Table S3

in_vitro_fidelity.source: Xing X, Kane DP, Bulock CR, et al. Nat Commun. 2019;10:374. PMCID PMC6343027
in_vitro_fidelity.system: M13mp2 lacZ forward assay, purified four-subunit Pol-epsilon holoenzyme, S-phase dNTP pools, with RPA/RFC/PCNA. No mismatch repair present.

mismatch_partitioning.source: Xing X, Kane DP, Bulock CR, et al. Nat Commun. 2019;10:374
verbatim_quotes: excised the mismatched T in 22% of cases, while 78% of products resulted from extension of the abnormal primer terminus
corrected the mismatch in 91% of cases, and only 9% of products resulted from direct extension

mmr_interaction.source: Xing X, et al. Nat Commun. 2019;10:374, Fig. 2b
mmr_interaction.finding: pol2-P301R msh6-delta is synthetic lethal; pol2-4 msh6-delta double mutants are viable.
mmr_interaction.implication: Mismatch repair remains essential for viability of the P301R single mutant, so P301R errors are not fully MMR-refractory.

sources: Xing X, et al. Nat Commun. 2019;10:374
Parkash V, Kulkarni Y, ter Beek J, et al. Nat Commun. 2019;10:373. PMCID PMC6342957
exonuclease_activity_caveat.note: Both 2019 papers report P301R exonuclease activity only qualitatively (gel-based: 'significantly reduced but still detectable'; 'degrades a smaller fraction of the primer at all tested concentrations'). Parkash reports the structural correlate: the exonuclease B-site metal ion is absent in P301R ('The B-site was not occupied by a metal in the P301R structure.'). No k_cat, K_m or partition rate constant exists in this literature for P301R or P286R, so no kinetic parameter is fitted here.
